Code: Attach PDF uses U18 createPendingPdf -> storage.stagePdf, then mutate (immutable, revision+1) sets source.pdf (App.tsx:491-506); errors via run banner; Remove PDF clears the reference only via patch({pdf: undefined}) through the Research onChange mutate (ResearchPanel.tsx ~:454), bytes left. Sidebar: depth-1 child row pdf:<sourceId> with beside {kind pdf} right after its source (App.tsx:1897; ProjectSidebar beside/open-beside button). PdfPane: blob object URL from readPdf, revoked in effect cleanup, missing/failed read -> 'This PDF is not stored in this project.'; no network; CSP frame-src self blob: (tauri.conf.json:23). Split invariants: split.ts focusSide never focuses a pdf pane, openBeside keeps left focused, readSplit forces focused left for pdf, activeOf/editorFor only resolve entry panes; splitPanes is null for a pdf right pane so editorFor/focusedPane use single-editor resolution (correct: one editor). My runs (pinned Node 22.23.3): tsc 0; vitest src/assets src/model.test.ts 82/82; own build ui2-u19-review/dist port 1562: research-pdf --repeat-each 2 4/4, split-view+research+sidebar-selection 28/28; fail-first rerun of research-pdf on ui2-u16/dist: 2/2 fail (no PDF input). Probe (scratchpad, not in repo) 1/1: sidebar rows [Bibliography d0, Probe source d0, probe.pdf d1]; right pane has no contenteditable, one format bar, clicking PDF pane header keeps left focused; typed text in left saved across close + two reloads; old blob URL revoked after close; persisted split whose PDF was removed reopens with the alert pane (safe, closable). Native: viewed research light/dark + pdf-preview light/dark in t125-diag and t125-diag-color (Attach PDF... visible, export PDF drawn); all 4 reports ok, pdfProbe application/pdf 622x538; baseline.log and beta.log exit 0. App.tsx/PdfPane.tsx last modified 05:59, before the 06:13 reliability run and 21:23 screens. EVIDENCE BOUNDARY: no native PNG shows PdfPane in the split pane; its native rendering is INFERRED from the U17 probe via the same blob-in-iframe mechanism (ExportPanel.tsx:247), as the plan allows. Non-blocking for U20 later-fixes: (a) removing a PDF (or deleting its source) while it is open leaves the split showing the alert instead of closing -- prune() checks sourceIds, not source.pdf (split.ts prune); (b) size label is B/KB only, 25 MB reads 25600.0 KB (ResearchPanel.tsx source-pdf-size); (c) the request listener in research-pdf.spec.ts:33 attaches after goto, so initial-load requests are not checked. All touched paths unowned at review time.
